reach.calibration: uncalibrated: conversion is unknown until the paid test

sources.population: any website owner installing a Chatbase agent

steps.detail: Brain sets up 2 secondary sending domains and inboxes in the connected Instantly account, a one-page offer with a Stripe payment link at $999, and a Chatbase account; spend capped at $200.
steps.label: Set up sending infrastructure and offer page

steps.detail: Brain emails 300 US local service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, dental, legal) with a demo assistant trained on their own site; replies handled by Brain; payment only via Stripe link.
steps.label: Week-1 paid test

steps.detail: Brain builds the Chatbase agent on the buyer's site content and delivers the embed snippet or WordPress plugin install; buyer pastes it or grants site access.
steps.label: Fulfil each paid order

steps.detail: If the threshold passes, scale outreach to about 3,300 prospects over days 8 to 25 within the $2,000 cap; if it fails, stop and re-plan with the next opening.
steps.label: Scale or stop

strategy.title: Fixed-price $999 AI chat/FAQ assistant setup for US local service businesses, sold by cold email, fulfilled on Chatbase
strategy.why: Most evidenced opening on the goal: published $999 one-time price, 135,665 US establishments in the buyer pool, fulfilment fully in software (Chatbase embed), Stripe settlement inside 7 days, about $200 pre-proof exposure, and no owner physical work.

validation.proof: at least one $999 payment collected in Stripe by day 10, before cumulative spend exceeds $300
validation.stop: no payment from 300 prospects by day 10, or spend reaches $300 without a payment: stop this opening and re-plan
